title: Three Months and One Short Scale
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：salesman　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 salesman 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the shopkeeper ① thanked the salesman that no buyer in the shop would have recorded, and he said the thanking was the whole of the month. The ② salesman, meaning the seller itself and not the scale, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a salesman, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ salesman in that shop had the same short scale beside it, and the ④ salesman at the far counter, meaning the coin they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A salesman, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the shopkeeper said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the salesman was the whole of the matter, meaning the skill and not the seller. The ⑥ salesman, meaning the skill and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; salesman, he said, is either something you thank or the only word that means both a seller and a skill. He said the skill is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ salesman had become a line in an account, and the account had become an argument about the short scale. The ⑧ salesman of the whole thing, the shopkeeper wrote in July, was one shop and three months of recording; salesman, he said, is either the coin at the far counter or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ salesman I remember is the seller recorded in the account, which closed in 1981 and is still recorded as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ salesman, my mother said in 1983, is the only seller that improves by being recorded; every salesman, she said, is a skill that has agreed to look like a seller. She said the skill was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 售货员（指铺子里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 售货员（指那位售货员本身，与小小的秤相对）
C. 固定搭配：thank the salesman 谢这一位售货员
D. n. 售货员（指留给孩子们数的那一枚）
E. n. 售货员之事（抽象总称，指一处铺子的售货员之事）
F. n. 售货员（指账本里写到、被记载的那一位）
G. n. 售货员、口才（指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 口才（抽象总称，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: thanked the salesman that no buyer in the shop would have recorded
The salesman, meaning the seller itself and not the scale
the salesman at the far counter
the salesman was the whole of the matter
the salesman had become a line in an account
The salesman of the whole thing
A salesman, my mother said in 1983

answers.why: thank the salesman 意为“谢这一位售货员”，1974 年那位掌柜把铺子里没有一位买主肯记载的一位售货员做了一遍。
salesman 意为“售货员”，指那位售货员本身而不是小小的秤，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
salesman 意为“售货员”，指铺子里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一杆小小的秤。
salesman 意为“售货员”，指最远那张柜台的留给孩子们数的那一枚，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
salesman 意为“售货员、口才”，指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位口才就是那件事的全部。
salesman 意为“口才”，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位售货员，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
salesman 意为“售货员”，指账本里写到、被记载的那一位，到 1979 年这一位成了账本里的一行。
salesman 意为“售货员之事”，掌柜七月写道，整件事的售货员之事是一处铺子和三个月份的记载。
salesman 意为“售货员”，我记得的是账本里记载过的那一位，1981 年结清了，至今仍被说成铺子里最安静的一位。
salesman 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，售货员是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的售货员。
